info.name: Collecting 400 Cursed Dolls
info.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

descriptions.inProgress: Rowen asked me again, this time #b400 cursed dolls#k. 400?? Hmmm...it's getting quite serious now...
descriptions.completed: I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all #b400 cursed dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me 5 very-hard-to-find ores. Will the forest really return to normal with this?
